question: Which summit is scheduled to be held at the Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai, in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **World Audio Visual & Entertainment Summit** is scheduled to be held at the Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai, in May 2023.
 
• This summit focuses on innovations and developments in the **audio-visual and entertainment industry**.
 
• It serves as a platform for **industry leaders, creators, and technologists** to showcase advancements and collaborate on future projects.
 
• The summit aims to **promote India's audio-visual industry** globally and enhance its competitiveness.
 
• Participants include **content creators, filmmakers, producers, technology providers, and policy makers** from India and around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **audio-visual industry** encompasses film, television, music, gaming, and digital content creation.
 
• India is one of the **largest producers of films** globally, with Bollywood being a major contributor.
 
• The **entertainment sector** in India is experiencing rapid growth due to increased digital consumption and technological advancements.
 
• Technologies such as **Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and cloud-based solutions** are revolutionizing the audio-visual landscape.
 
• Government initiatives like **Make in India** and support for digital content creation have boosted the entertainment and media sector's growth.
